name: Snail
summary: Flat vector garden snail with a brown spiral shell, soft tan body and eye stalks; crawls slowly.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 200 px long at s = 1

params.name: pose
params.note: idle = slow eye-stalk sway; crawl = body stretches in a slow wave and eye stalks swing

params.name: vx
params.note: px per frame drift (use a small value, e.g. 0.6, for a slow crawl)

author: krakujs
